auth.reason: FanBasis became Commas on 2026-07-14. Current first-party Commas pages document APIs, SDKs, and an MCP beta but publish no OAuth, API-key, bearer-token, or other authentication flow. The legacy Fanbasis API Docs site remains password-protected, so authentication cannot be verified from accessible official text. The rebrand page is undated as a publication; the login and product pages are undated.

api_surface.reason: Current first-party Commas pages confirm APIs and SDKs, but no accessible official page publishes REST, GraphQL, HTTP, gRPC, SOAP, endpoint schemas, or resource breadth. The legacy Fanbasis API Docs v3 site is password-protected, and the tested Commas /api, /docs, /mcp, and /developers routes return 404. API type and breadth therefore remain unknown rather than inferred from the word API.

verdict.reason: A checked build verdict is not supportable because current public Commas pages do not resolve API authentication, credential access, or API protocol/breadth, and the legacy API Docs site is password-protected. The MCP beta is documented but lacks public connection and access details. This does not establish that no public API exists. The reviewed pages are undated; the rebrand was effective 2026-07-14.
